verdict.rationale: A client portal or dashboard showing case status is a fair question for an immigration law firm, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a portal, dashboard, or case-status tracking. The only related material is a general promise of setting a case strategy and replying quickly to inquiries, which is an adjacent service commitment rather than a self-service view of where a case stands.

support.subject: As a founder, I can see where my case is — a client portal or dashboard with case status and next steps is a documented part of the product
